name: Baring Fangs
source:
The days have grown shorter and the nights, colder. Your stomach aches with hunger and your legs are dull with pain. The leaves crunch under your feet as your press onward, stubbornly tracking your mark. Suddenly, a howl cuts through the air. The source is nearby. You just hope the beasts aren't as hungry as you are.

Baring Fangs is a feature rich, gay visual novel.  You play as a human hunter lost in the wilderness with an impending winter threatening your survival. You must learn to cooperate with an unlikely companion - a strange wolf man by the name of Fang. During the frozen months you may learn far more about each other than what is first apparent. And perhaps... you will learn the heat of passion can rise even in winter.

[From [url=https://boroco.itch.io/baringfangs]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
白昼渐短，夜晚愈寒。你的胃因饥饿而绞痛，双腿也隐隐作痛。你固执地追踪着目标，继续前行，脚下的落叶沙沙作响。突然，一声嚎叫划破空气，声音来自不远处。你只希望，那些野兽没有你这么饿。

《Baring Fangs》是一部内容丰富的男性同性恋视觉小说。你将扮演迷失荒野的人类猎人，逼近的寒冬正威胁着你的生存。你必须学会与一个意想不到的伙伴合作——名叫Fang的奇怪狼人。在冰封的几个月里，你们或许会发现彼此身上远超最初印象的一面。也许……你还会发现，即使在冬天，热烈的情欲依然能够升温。

[摘自[url=https://boroco.itch.io/baringfangs]itch.io[/url]]
